mechanism: A decade-long drain from 23 to 6.5 left an intact but inert field (S_UF 0.80-0.92, almost no deaths, B pinned at -1.000), and the price lift off the low arrived as a single violent displacement on 08-12 (+14%) that the field never joined: zero ignitions the entire month and every daily lane reading negative (D- = 5/5) through four sessions while price was held flat at 8.6 — the spike sits on the field, not in it. The second push on 08-19 came with four intra-session reversals, mixed lanes, and participation thinning into the close (URF sinking 0.51 -> 0.36), the signature of an externally driven pulse being distributed rather than a re-knitting recovery. With no stored upward tension underneath, when the driving pressure stops the field relaxes back toward its pre-spike level.
